name: value
meaning: The selected value or displayed measurement; domain and type are component-specific.
whenToUse: Expose the primary selection or magnitude.
avoid: Do not infer editability, numeric universality or shared normalization.

name: defaultValue
meaning: The initial value of an uncontrolled interactive component.
whenToUse: An actual interactive API supports uncontrolled initialization.
avoid: Passive measurements such as Gauge or APIs without uncontrolled behavior.

name: onValueChange
meaning: Notification of a user-driven value change in an interactive component.
whenToUse: The component actually emits selection or editing changes.
avoid: Passive displays such as Gauge or notifications for incoming prop updates.

name: size
meaning: Component-specific dimensions through supported presets or custom dimensions.
whenToUse: Choose dimensional presets or custom dimensions supported by the component.
avoid: Assuming identical dimensions or accepted types across components; Gauge numeric CSS-pixel support does not extend Tabs or IconButton. Gauge finite-positive validation, invalid-size behavior and any min/max policy still require review.

usages.type: GaugeSize | number (GaugeSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'; numeric CSS pixels, e.g. 64)

name: variant
meaning: Visual treatment within a component's responsibility.
whenToUse: Choose presentation such as an outline or segmented treatment.
avoid: Consumer-selected condition or Surface material tone.

name: tone
meaning: A component's color tone: a semantic status family or a material surface tone; values are component-specific.
whenToUse: Select the tone family a component supports, such as Badge or Mark status tones.
avoid: A consumer-selected measurement condition (use state), arbitrary colors, or assuming every component exposes the same tone values.

name: elevation
meaning: The elevation treatment of a material surface.
whenToUse: A surface exposes a supported elevation axis.
avoid: Condition, dimensions or an arbitrary shadow value.

name: label
meaning: The accessible name of the control or displayed magnitude.
whenToUse: The public API owns an explicit accessible-name input.
avoid: Assuming Surface has this prop or using it as a generic visible caption.

name: state
meaning: The consumer-selected interpretation of a Gauge magnitude, independent of thresholds.
whenToUse: Propose Gauge condition normal, warning, critical or muted.
avoid: Visual variants, material tone, loading behavior or automatic threshold inference.

name: stateText
meaning: Visible non-color text describing the selected Gauge condition.
whenToUse: Propose condition text, required for non-normal Gauge states by the draft union.
avoid: Replacing the accessible name or the numeric equivalent.

name: valueText
meaning: A contextual text equivalent of the normalized displayed measurement.
whenToUse: Propose a readable Gauge measurement equivalent coherent with clamping.
avoid: Condition text, accessible naming or an incoherent raw out-of-range value.

name: center
meaning: Optional decorative, non-interactive content inside the Gauge ring.
whenToUse: Propose an icon, value or short text with meaning already represented accessibly.
avoid: Actions, focusable descendants, a fixed logo or the sole source of meaning.

name: unavailableText
meaning: Readable fallback when a displayed measurement (Gauge, Stat) is unavailable and no value is exposed.
whenToUse: Propose non-empty unavailable-data text separately from invalid-input policy approval.
avoid: Loading, disabled state, fabricated zero measurements or assuming fallback wording is approved.

name: profile
meaning: A named preset of engine parameters for a decorative effect layer.
whenToUse: Select among the effect presets supported by the component, such as density and speed profiles.
avoid: Do not use it for visual Material treatment, sizes or arbitrary per-parameter overrides; preset names and values are component-specific.

name: opacity
meaning: The opacity of a decorative effect layer, a number from 0 to 1.
whenToUse: Let the consumer fade a decorative layer in or out; a component may stop its work at 0.
avoid: Do not use it as a general appearance override for interactive components or text; clamping and non-finite handling are component-specific.

name: badgeIcon
meaning: System glyph shown in a small decorative badge overlaid on a corner of the component, such as the network of a channel avatar.
whenToUse: Mark the origin or network of the represented entity with a corner glyph.
avoid: Leading glyphs next to content (use leading-icon/icon), counts or status (use Badge or StatusDot), or the sole source of meaning.

name: paused
meaning: Shows the represented entity as paused or inactive with visual de-emphasis and data-state="paused".
whenToUse: A channel, account or similar entity is paused and the meaning is also given in text.
avoid: Disabled controls (use native disabled), loading, or as the only cue for the paused meaning.

name: icon
meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology.
whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text.
avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning.

name: iconPosition
meaning: Which side of the visible label a component's decorative icon slot is rendered on.
whenToUse: A labelled control or link exposes an optional decorative icon that may lead or trail its label.
avoid: Icon-only controls, icon identity or size, or reordering meaningful content.

name: loading
meaning: The control has started an operation that is still pending; it stays focusable but cannot be activated again.
whenToUse: An action control shows in-progress feedback for an operation it triggered.
avoid: Disabled semantics, data-fetching placeholders, skeletons or progress with a known value.

name: asChild
meaning: Render the component's behavior and styling onto its single child element through Radix Slot instead of its default element.
whenToUse: A consumer must supply the element, such as an anchor or a router link, while keeping the component's contract.
avoid: Multiple children, wrapping non-element content, or changing the component's semantic role.

name: onCheckedChange
meaning: Notification of a user-driven change of a binary or mixed checked state, receiving the next checked state.
whenToUse: A checkbox or switch control emits its next checked state when the user toggles it.
avoid: Selection of a value among options (use onValueChange), pressed buttons (use onPressedChange), or notifications for incoming prop updates.

name: pressed
meaning: Controlled on/off pressed state of a toggle control, exposed as aria-pressed.
whenToUse: A single control persists an on/off state the user switches by pressing it.
avoid: Selection of a value from a set (use value), form checkbox semantics (checked) or transient active styling.

name: defaultPressed
meaning: Initial pressed state of an uncontrolled toggle control.
whenToUse: A toggle control supports uncontrolled use alongside the pressed prop.
avoid: Controlled components without uncontrolled behavior or value-based selection.

name: onPressedChange
meaning: Notification of a user-driven change of a toggle control's pressed state, with the next boolean.
whenToUse: A toggle control emits pressed changes from user interaction.
avoid: Value selection changes (use onValueChange) or notifications for incoming prop updates.

name: onFiles
meaning: Notification carrying the files the user picked, dropped or pasted into a file target.
whenToUse: A component accepts files from the user and hands them to the consumer for validation and upload.
avoid: Upload progress or results, value changes of non-file inputs, or validation feedback.

name: dropLabel
meaning: Visible text a drop target shows while compatible items are dragged over it.
whenToUse: A drop target replaces its resting text during drag-over, such as Drop here.
avoid: The resting accessible name, error messages or generic hover text.

name: name
meaning: Identifier of the glyph that the Icon component draws from the closed system icon set.
whenToUse: Select which system glyph Icon renders.
avoid: Icon slots inside other components (use leading-icon/icon), native form-control name attributes or arbitrary SVG content.

name: filled
meaning: Renders a stroke glyph with a solid currentColor fill in addition to its stroke.
whenToUse: A glyph needs its solid form, such as a play triangle.
avoid: Selected, pressed or active state, or any color change.

name: external
meaning: The link opens its destination in a new browsing context with safe rel values and an external cue.
whenToUse: A navigational component links to a destination that should open in a new tab, usually outside the product.
avoid: Marking same-tab links as external, download behavior, or styling-only treatments.

name: newTabText
meaning: Readable text announcing that a link opens in a new tab, rendered for assistive technology.
whenToUse: A component that can open a new tab lets consumers localize the notice.
avoid: Replacing the link's accessible name or describing the destination.

name: arrow
meaning: Whether a link shows its trailing decorative direction arrow; the glyph is derived by the component.
whenToUse: A text link may hide its built-in arrow, for example in legal or dense footer links.
avoid: Choosing arbitrary icons or conveying meaning through the arrow alone.

name: rule
meaning: Short code or letter of the review rule that flagged a piece of content, shown next to it.
whenToUse: A highlighted fragment must show which linter or style rule produced it, linking it to its notice.
avoid: Status tone, accessible naming, validation rules of form fields or long rule descriptions.

name: monogram
meaning: The one or two visible characters that identify a product in a compact brand mark.
whenToUse: A compact product mark shows letters instead of artwork.
avoid: Accessible naming (use accessible-name/label), user initials in avatars, or long text.

name: edge
meaning: Pins a thin decorative-or-status strip to the bottom edge of its positioned container, spanning its full width.
whenToUse: A progress or status strip must sit flush on a container edge, such as the SectionNav button.
avoid: Generic positioning, side selection for floating content or layout overrides; the container must be positioned and clip overflow.

name: options
meaning: Ordered list of selectable options, each with a value, a visible text label and optional per-option disabled state; item shape is component-specific.
whenToUse: A selection component renders a standard item for each option from data.
avoid: Custom item rendering (compose primitives instead), navigation items or arbitrary ReactNode collections.

name: orientation
meaning: Main axis of a component's items, which also sets its arrow-key navigation axis.
whenToUse: A component lays out a collection along one axis and its keyboard model follows that axis.
avoid: Purely visual direction changes without keyboard impact, or text direction (use dir).

name: placeholder
meaning: Hint text shown in a choice control while no value is selected; not the accessible name or a default value.
whenToUse: A non-native choice control (such as a Radix Select trigger) needs the equivalent of a native input placeholder.
avoid: Native inputs and textareas, which already have the placeholder attribute; using it as a label, instruction that must stay visible, or selected value.

name: onValueCommit
meaning: Notification of the final value when the user ends a continuous interaction such as a drag or a keyboard step.
whenToUse: A continuous control lets consumers defer expensive work until the user settles on a value, alongside onValueChange.
avoid: Discrete selections where every change is final, form submission or notifications for incoming prop updates.

name: delta
meaning: Short secondary text that gives context to a displayed figure, such as its latest change or why it is unavailable.
whenToUse: A figure component shows a one-line change summary or a no-data reason under its value.
avoid: Accessible naming, long descriptions, help text for form fields or the figure itself.

name: highlighted
meaning: Consumer-controlled, temporary emphasis that draws attention to a component after its content changed.
whenToUse: The consumer briefly emphasizes one item (for example a live total that just changed) and removes the emphasis itself.
avoid: Selection, pressed or current state, persistent status tones, or component-managed timers.

name: pulse
meaning: Whether a live or attention signal indicator plays its pulse animation; reduced-motion preferences always stop it.
whenToUse: A decorative signal indicator offers an optional pulsing emphasis that the consumer can switch to a static presentation.
avoid: Loading or progress animation, general motion toggles for interactive components, or conveying meaning only through motion.

name: content
meaning: Supplementary plain text shown by a floating hint attached to a trigger.
whenToUse: A tooltip-like component shows a short, non-essential, non-interactive description on hover or focus.
avoid: Accessible names, essential instructions, interactive or rich content, or page content slots.

name: side
meaning: The preferred side of the trigger where floating content is placed before collision handling.
whenToUse: A floating component (tooltip, popover, menu) lets the consumer choose top, right, bottom or left.
avoid: Edge pinning inside a container, text direction or alignment along the side.
